Ritual, metalwork & writing / Text C1

青铜时代的
礼仪与技术

这份中英双语页面讲述青铜时代的中国如何形成礼制传统、发展文字与青铜铸造技术，并通过区域交流连接不同文化，页面配有大量历史图片。
This bilingual Chinese–English page tells the story of how Bronze Age China developed ritual traditions, writing and bronze-casting technology, and connected different regional cultures through exchange, with plenty of historical images along the way.

青铜器不只是金属制品，也是礼制、权力与工艺网络的一部分。陶范铸造、铭文和区域交流，呈现了早期国家如何组织资源，并把技术转化为社会秩序。
Bronze objects were not simply metalwork: they formed part of ritual, power and craft networks. Piece-mould casting, inscriptions and regional exchange show how early states organised resources and turned technology into social order.

BRONZE AGE / 青铜时代
01 · Ritual & technology

青铜时代的礼仪与技术Bronze Age ritual and technology

青铜器不只是金属制品，也是礼制、权力与工艺网络的一部分。陶范铸造、铭文和区域交流，呈现了早期国家如何组织资源，并把技术转化为社会秩序。Bronze objects were not simply metalwork: they formed part of ritual, power and craft networks. Piece-mould casting, inscriptions and regional exchange show how early states organised resources and turned technology into social order.

01 · Ritual power

礼器与权力Ritual vessels and authority

技术
陶范分铸、合金配比
用途
祭祀、宴飨、赏赐与纪念

商周贵族用鼎、簋、爵等青铜器举行礼仪活动。器形大小、数量和组合往往与身份、政治关系相关，铭文还记录战争、赏赐、诉讼和家族纪念。Shang and Zhou elites used ding, gui, jue and other bronzes in ritual. Vessel types, numbers and combinations could express status and political relationships, while inscriptions recorded campaigns, gifts and family events.

青铜器把技术、礼仪与政治权力连接在同一套物质系统中。 Bronzes connected technology, ritual and political power within one material system.

02 · Regional networks

区域交流与多元传统Regional exchange and plural traditions

地点
四川盆地，三星堆遗址
特征
大型面具、神树与祭祀遗存

三星堆表明，早期青铜文明并非只沿黄河中游发展。四川盆地形成了独特的祭祀体系和视觉传统，同时通过玉石、金属和观念交流，与更广阔的区域保持联系。Sanxingdui shows that early bronze cultures did not develop only in the middle Yellow River region. The Sichuan Basin produced a distinct ritual and visual tradition while remaining connected to wider networks through jade, metal and ideas.

不同区域共享技术背景，却发展出不同的礼仪表达。 Different regions shared technical knowledge but developed distinct ritual expressions.

03 · Writing

占卜、记录与文字Divination, records and writing

材料
龟甲与兽骨
内容
祭祀、战争、天气、收成与王室事务

商王通过整治、灼烧甲骨并观察裂纹来占卜，问题与结果常被刻在骨面上。这些文字构成现存最早、成体系的汉字材料之一，也让研究者得以重建王室活动和日常关注。Shang rulers divined by preparing and heating oracle bones, then reading the cracks. Questions and outcomes were often inscribed on the bone. These texts form one of the earliest mature Chinese writing systems and help researchers reconstruct royal concerns and activities.

文字既是宗教实践的一部分，也是行政和记忆技术。 Writing was both part of ritual practice and a technology of administration and memory.

关键概念：陶范铸造
KEY IDEA · PIECE-MOULD CASTING

工匠先用泥土制作内范和外范，再将熔融青铜注入两者之间的空隙。复杂器物需要分部件铸造并连接，因此大型礼器背后是采矿、运输、制模、熔炼与协作的系统工程。Craftspeople made inner and outer clay moulds, then poured molten bronze into the space between them. Complex vessels required separate parts and joining, making large bronzes a system of mining, transport, mould-making, smelting and coordinated labour.

延伸思考THINK FURTHER

青铜礼器依靠稀缺金属、复杂铸造和礼仪制度建立价值。请比较一件大型礼器从采矿、制模、熔铸到使用的完整链条：技术、劳动力和政治权力分别在哪里发挥作用？Ritual bronzes created value through scarce metal, complex casting and ceremonial institutions. Trace one large vessel from mining and mould-making to casting and use: where do technology, labour and political power each matter?
